draft.title: GST
card: GST is the Goods and Services Tax. In Australia it is 10% of the price on most goods and services. Some items, such as basic fresh food, do not have it.
Adding GST
Multiply the price before GST by 1.1. Example: a $60 repair becomes $60 × 1.1 = $66. The GST is $6.
Finding the GST
A price with GST included is 110% of the original, so the GST is 1/11 of it. Divide the GST-inclusive price by 11.
Example
A jacket costs $154 with GST included. The GST is $154 ÷ 11 = $14. The price before GST is $154 − $14 = $140.
draft.remember: Add GST by multiplying by 1.1. To find the GST in a price that includes it, divide by 11.

a.q: A tradesperson charges $250 before GST. What is the price with 10% GST added?
a.why: The price with GST is $250 × 1.1 = $275. Dividing by 11 gives $22.73, which is the method for a price that already includes GST, and it does not add GST to $250.
a.clue: The new price is 110% of the starting price.

b.q: Mia pays $187 for a printer, and the price includes GST. How much of the $187 is GST?
b.why: The price includes GST, so the GST is $187 ÷ 11 = $17. Taking 10% of $187 gives $18.70, which is tempting but wrong, because $187 is 110% of the original price and not 100%.
b.clue: The $187 is already 110% of the price before GST.
